                       register,

from glom.reduction import Sum, Fold, Flatten, flatten, FoldError, Merge, merge
from glom.mutation import Assign, assign, PathAssignError

# Import constants module
from glom import constants as _constants

# Set up consts as deprecated alias for constants
def _get_consts():
    import warnings
    warnings.warn(
        "glom.consts is deprecated, use glom.constants instead",
        DeprecationWarning,
        stacklevel=2
    )
    return _constants

import sys
_glom_module = sys.modules[__name__]
_glom_module.constants = _constants
_glom_module.consts = _get_consts()
